scope: Public headline claims, model outputs and demonstration evidence. Repository sources below document implementation; they are not independent validation of the underlying science.

claims.calculation: Historical crop water balance; irrigation mm times 10 equals m3/ha. Compare the same crop seasons against the stated current rotation, retaining signed differences.
claims.assumptions: Crop coefficients, durations, initial water storage and rice seepage are modeled. Annual comparison excludes Aman rescue volume; rescue frequency is separate. Irrigation source, delivery losses and return flows are not measured.
claims.allowed: The model estimates lower or higher crop irrigation demand than the named comparator.
claims.notAllowed: We saved six million litres, measured farm water savings, or replenished the aquifer.

claims.calculation: District storage trend in mm/year times district area times 10; divide by modeled Boro-to-alternative irrigation difference per hectare to obtain an illustrative equivalent area.
claims.assumptions: GLDAS-2.2 GRACE-assimilated storage is modeled regional context. Recharge, return flows, other withdrawals and irrigation sources are omitted; a volume equivalence is not a causal water budget.
claims.allowed: Illustrative irrigation-volume equivalent of a modeled district storage trend.
claims.notAllowed: Changing this percentage of farms will stop groundwater decline or restore the aquifer.

claims.calculation: Compare current practice, calendar-only selection and the seven-dimension model with fixed farmer priorities; remove GLDAS, current moisture, IMERG harvest risk and OPERA individually, with SRDI separately.
claims.assumptions: All outcomes are measured by the same model. Calendar candidates share the catalog and available sowing dates. The frozen cases have no current SMAP reading. Changes do not imply improvements.
claims.allowed: This input changes this modeled choice, or leaves it unchanged; no observed benefit is established.
claims.notAllowed: NASA improves outcomes in all three settings or current-moisture data helped when no reading was supplied.

claims.calculation: Select using 2001–2015, freeze the choice and evaluate 2016–2024. Both policies choose dhan71–mustard in this experiment.
claims.assumptions: Retrospective simulated outcomes, previously explored parameters, nine complete later Aman–winter pairs. Not the production seven-dimension selector and not independent farm observations.
claims.allowed: No incremental advantage over the calendar rule in this frozen pilot experiment.
claims.notAllowed: A validated predictive advantage, pristine holdout, or nationwide result.

claims.calculation: Compare classified water pixels for nearby NISAR and OPERA observations using research/explore/nisar_calibration.py; report sample, threshold, dates and kappa with any percentage.
claims.assumptions: OPERA is a satellite comparator, not ground truth. Thresholds were explored on these pairs. Repeated pixels are spatially correlated; coastal disagreement matters.
claims.allowed: About 83% cross-sensor water-classification agreement in the recorded paired sample; this is not planting-date validation.
claims.notAllowed: 83.4% accurate planting dates, verified drainage forecasts, or 83% ground-truth accuracy.

claims.calculation: Prefix-only same-sensor seasonal-peak and recent-trend slopes project the below-5% regional extra-water threshold. Envelope of both predictions widened by the observation gap, at most 14 days; maximum 45-day horizon.
claims.assumptions: Five pilot sites have no evaluable future threshold crossings in the stored sample. Broader 544-location exploration is post hoc; overlapping origins are not independent. Last-year proxy has a different water definition. Observation intervals are not exact drainage dates.
claims.allowed: A provisional regional method/sampling range. Later range endpoint informs tentative low-land calendar feasibility; check access, soil workability, water and salinity before planting.
claims.notAllowed: A calibrated confidence interval, safe planting date, validated flood-arrival forecast, or peak-method superiority over recent trend.

claims.calculation: All four stored rainfall thresholds versus seven directly labeled years: four flood and three no-flood, with 18 unknown. At 200 mm: two detected, two missed, zero of three negatives flagged.
claims.assumptions: Broad regional seasonal labels, explored historical IMERG Final data and no independent arrival dates. Indirect 2004 label is separate. Unknown is never negative.
claims.allowed: A historical rainfall association with explicit missed years and small event counts.
claims.notAllowed: Reliable warning lead time, zero false alarms generally, all floods detected, or avoided crop loss.

claims.calculation: Winter crop base 0.9 legume, 0.45 rice or 0.7 other; crop-sequence and low-organic-matter modifiers, clamped 0.1–0.95. Fertilizer quantities only with applicable source inputs.
claims.assumptions: Team-designed heuristic using crop traits and regional SRDI context. It is not a soil process model or before/after field measurement.
claims.allowed: A soil-practice preference score, with source-specific fertilizer information where available.
claims.notAllowed: Measured soil-health improvement, soil carbon sequestration, or a probability of soil recovery.

claims.calculation: 544 geoBoundaries ADM3 records joined to upazila context and district/pilot weather replays; native source resolution remains distinct from display geography.
claims.assumptions: Administrative coverage does not mean fresh complete observations or field-specific accuracy at every location. District climate can be shared by many upazilas. A 1 km greenness aggregation grid does not increase the resolution of other sources.
claims.allowed: 544 upazila contexts combined with district weather replays, with source-specific resolution and missing data.
claims.notAllowed: 544 independently validated weather models or 1 km precision for every measurement.

claims.calculation: Count entries in the landing DATASETS inventory: POWER, IMERG, MODIS, VIIRS, NISAR, OPERA, GRACE/GLDAS, NASADEM, SMAP, HLS, MERRA-2, ECOSTRESS, SEDAC and GIBS.
claims.assumptions: Fourteen source/service families, not fourteen independent predictors. POWER and MERRA-2 overlap; GRACE/GLDAS is grouped. ECOSTRESS is exploratory, GIBS is display, MODIS/VIIRS/HLS largely context. A source may be absent or stale for a place.
claims.allowed: 14 NASA-linked source families and display services, with their distinct roles disclosed.
claims.notAllowed: Every decision combines 14 independent NASA measurements or all 14 are current at every field.

claims.calculation: Aman history spans 2001–2025; the pilot winter source ends before a complete 2025–26 pair. The temporal comparison uses 24 complete pairs, split 15 training and 9 evaluation.
claims.assumptions: Different products and derived records have different dates; a headline history span is not the number of usable observations in every calculation.
claims.allowed: Historical replay with the period and available season count stated for the particular result.
claims.notAllowed: 25 complete Aman–winter pairs in the pilot temporal comparison.

claims.calculation: Crop yield/price/cost assumptions plus straw or by-products where modeled; stress cost deltas per planted crop and irrigation m3. Local missing crop income can use a disclosed proxy.
claims.assumptions: Published averages and team assumptions are not this farmer's present prices, realized yield, debt or household income. Fallow's non-crop costs and benefits are unknown.
claims.allowed: Illustrative net crop return under stated assumptions.
claims.notAllowed: Guaranteed profit, observed farmer income gain, or a forecast market price.

claims.calculation: Rerun generation, calendars, checks and scores under costs ±5,000 BDT/ha per crop, irrigation +2 BDT/m3, Aman +7 days, winter ±10 days, initial water 25/75 mm, combined stress and coastal salinity ±25%; priorities fixed.
claims.assumptions: Engineering bounds, not empirical distributions. Duration uses average daily demand, not a weather/phenology replay. Existing heat and Aman rescue frequencies stay fixed. The strong-salinity review threshold is a policy choice.
claims.allowed: Stable within tested assumptions, review required, or insufficient evidence; final recommendation withheld where appropriate.
claims.notAllowed: 90% certain to succeed, robust to all climate uncertainty, or scientifically calibrated confidence.

claims.calculation: SRDI 2009 area shares by salinity class, class-midpoint EC and crop tolerance curves yield a modeled regional crop suitability penalty.
claims.assumptions: Old regional survey, seasonal salinity variation and unknown field EC. Not a NASA salinity measurement; field tests are needed.
claims.allowed: A regional salinity screening scenario informed by SRDI, with final choice withheld where evidence is insufficient.
claims.notAllowed: NASA measured this field's current soil salinity or validated its crop yield.

claims.calculation: Crop-linked PEST-CHEMGRIDS estimates, crop rotation heuristics and ledger factors compare pesticide load and ecological practices.
claims.assumptions: Gridded estimates and generic factors are not actual applications, pesticide exposure, biodiversity counts or verified emissions. Lower score/load does not establish avoided health harm.
claims.allowed: Estimated pesticide load and practice-based ecological indicators for discussion.
claims.notAllowed: Measured pesticide reduction, health protection, carbon credits or biodiversity recovery.

claims.calculation: Screen each source independently: soil/rain/disease 7 days, field weather 2, flood/recession 21; reject future/invalid dates. Forecast starts today/tomorrow. Narration facts come from approved templates; an optional model selects only a permitted style.
claims.assumptions: Age cutoffs are operational policy, not accuracy guarantees. Regional observations can miss field conditions. Exact template membership validates message integrity, not agronomy.
claims.allowed: Dated, screened observations and controlled narration with explicit uncertainty.
claims.notAllowed: Hallucination-proof science, always-live data or a scientifically validated message merely because text checks passed.

claims.calculation: Erosion values are fixed authored examples with no per-value observation dates or citations. Cattle advice applies weather-based heat-stress rules.
claims.assumptions: Erosion reference organizations do not substantiate each example value. Cattle guidance has not been validated on local animals. Neither establishes crop-rotation skill.
claims.allowed: Secondary demonstration modules; erosion is explicitly illustrative static data, cattle is general rule-based heat guidance.
claims.notAllowed: A live erosion forecast, measured bank movement or validated animal-health outcome.

claims.calculation: Zero farmer/officer testing sessions reported by the project owner in this development task.
claims.assumptions: Synthetic scenarios and officer-review rehearsal checkboxes are not interviews, field verification, consent or endorsements.
claims.allowed: A working hackathon prototype with reproducible tests; field and comprehension validation remain outstanding.
claims.notAllowed: Farmer-tested, officer-approved, adopted in practice or proven to improve livelihoods.
